staged_source_snapshot.description: Stage 01 reproduced against this staged vulnerable snapshot. Its line map matches the saved ASan trace (`process_page_` line 130, `check_size_of_link_allocation_` line 152, `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link` line 668, and `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_` line 3873); sample metadata names `a0e30a4ef2539406bcb4bea63c2983eb98363b0f`, an earlier still-vulnerable commit with the same pre-fix skip-link behavior.

bug_description.original: OSS-Fuzz issue 379254072 (flac): Heap-buffer-overflow READ 4 found by fuzz target fuzzer_seek [asan]. https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/379254072
bug_description.original_source: sample_info.json issue_description / saved sanitizer_trace.txt / exact staged vulnerable source / staged patch.diff
bug_description.normalized: The exact staged 756034-byte `fuzzer_seek` witness uses prefix bytes `75 17 ff` to inject one later allocation failure at `alloc_check_threshold = 117`, select Ogg mode, enable chained-stream decoding, and expose a 15-byte command stream `end_of_stream`, `finish_link`, `process_until_end_of_link`, `finish_link`, `flush`, `seek_long(0x6969696969696969)`, then a trailing `process_until_end_of_link` byte that is never reached because the seek already crashes. The saved ASan allocation stack shows the initial `process_until_end_of_stream()` command successfully growing `aspect->linkdetails` to the 3808-byte heap region later named by the crash, i.e. 68 `FLAC__OggDecoderAspect_LinkDetails` entries. A later read-side chained-EOS transition inside `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper()` sets `current_linknumber_advance_read = current_linknumber + 1` and then hits the witness's one injected `safe_realloc_nofree_mul_2op_()` failure while trying to grow past 68 entries, so the stale read-side state is translated into `FLAC__OGG_DECODER_ASPECT_READ_STATUS_MEMORY_ALLOCATION_ERROR -> FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_READ_STATUS_ABORT -> FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_ABORTED`. The saved artifacts do not distinguish whether that abort is absorbed by the initial `process_until_end_of_stream()` call or by the later `process_until_end_of_link()` command, but the staged source shows that only a `frame_sync_()`-mediated exit can keep `decoder_valid` true and leave the later `finish_link` / `process_until_end_of_link` / `finish_link` bytes harmless, which is what makes the explicit `FLAC__stream_decoder_flush()` reachable on the same decoder object. That `flush()` resets the public decoder state to `SEARCH_FOR_FRAME_SYNC` but does not reset the stale Ogg link indices. In the vulnerable revision, `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()` begins the later seek without re-running `check_size_of_link_allocation_()`, so its beginning-of-link BOS scan in `process_page_()` binds `current_link = &aspect->linkdetails[68]` and immediately reads `current_link->number_of_other_streams`, producing the observed 4-byte heap-buffer-overflow 32 bytes past the 3808-byte region. The fix adds the missing upfront `check_size_of_link_allocation_()` retry in `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()` and changes `linkdetails` growth from `+4` chunks to doubling.

source.description: First project-side materialization of witness-controlled state on the crashing path. The prefix byte `0x17` makes this setter enable chained Ogg decoding, which is what turns later EOS handling into multi-link bookkeeping with `current_linknumber` and `current_linknumber_advance_read` instead of terminating the stream.
source.value_from: The exact witness prefix is `75 17 ff`: byte 1 (`0x17`) makes `oss-fuzz/seek.cc` set `init_bools[0]` and `init_bools[4]`, so the harness chooses `FLAC__stream_decoder_init_ogg_file()` and calls `FLAC__stream_decoder_set_decode_chained_stream(decoder, true)`. Byte 0 simultaneously sets `alloc_check_threshold = 117`, and byte 2 gives the 15-byte command stream that later issues `flush` and `seek_long(0x6969696969696969)` on the same decoder object.

sink.description: ASan crash site. `process_page_()` reads the 4-byte `number_of_other_streams` field from `current_link = &aspect->linkdetails[68]`, which is one entry past the 68-slot heap allocation still live on the crashing seek path.
sink.note: The saved sanitizer trace reports `READ of size 4` at `src/libFLAC/ogg_decoder_aspect.c:130:23` on an address 32 bytes past the 3808-byte `linkdetails` region, matching the offset of `number_of_other_streams` inside the missing element 68.

root_cause.description: Missing retry of `check_size_of_link_allocation_()`. `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()` starts the later seek with stale link indices inherited from an earlier read-side growth failure, but the vulnerable function branches immediately instead of first repairing or rejecting the out-of-range `current_linknumber_advance_read` state. The fix adds exactly that helper call above this line.

tainted_value_origin.description: This read-side chained-EOS assignment creates the concrete stale selector later consumed by the sink. On the crashing state it advances the read-ahead link index from 67 to 68 before capacity has been re-established.

parser_admitted.description: The exact witness's first command is `process_until_end_of_stream(decoder)`, so attacker-controlled payload bytes do enter `read_callback_ogg_aspect_()` and the Ogg link-bookkeeping code before the later explicit `flush` and crashing seek. The saved artifacts do not prove that this first command completed the whole stream before the later read-side allocation failure.
parser_admitted.condition: byte 1 (`0x17`) makes `ogg` and `decode_chained_stream` true, and the first command byte `0x20` selects `process_until_end_of_stream`.

crashing_seek.description: The witness's `seek_long` command requests `0x6969696969696969` after an explicit `flush`. The saved crash stack shows this exact call enters `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_()` and crashes in `process_page_()` before the trailing command byte can run.

evidence_limitations: The saved artifacts do not distinguish whether the read-side allocation failure that produced stale index 68 was absorbed by the initial `process_until_end_of_stream()` command or by the later `process_until_end_of_link()` command. The narrower source-grounded fact used here is that it must have surfaced through a `frame_sync_()` caller, because only `FLAC__stream_decoder_process_until_end_of_stream()` lines 1173-1175 and `FLAC__stream_decoder_process_until_end_of_link()` lines 1107-1110 can return true after `read_callback_()` has already set `FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_ABORTED`.

The Ogg/FLAC payload after byte offset 18 is preserved only as the exact staged `poc`. The saved artifacts do not support a broader claim about neighboring payloads or alternative callback chunking beyond this witness.

coarse_trace.summary: The harness interprets prefix `75 17 ff` as single-failure allocation fuzzing plus Ogg chained-stream mode, then runs the exact command sequence `end_of_stream`, `finish_link`, `process_until_end_of_link`, `finish_link`, `flush`, and `seek_long(0x6969696969696969)` over the remaining Ogg FLAC payload.

The saved allocation stack shows the initial `process_until_end_of_stream()` command growing `linkdetails` to a 68-slot heap allocation. Later, a read-side chained-EOS transition on the same decoder object advances `current_linknumber_advance_read` and then hits the witness's one injected allocation failure, which the decoder read shim collapses to `FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_ABORTED`.

A `frame_sync_()`-mediated public read command can absorb that abort without stopping the harness, and the intervening `finish_link` / `process_until_end_of_link` / `finish_link` bytes do not repair the stale Ogg state. The explicit `flush` then resets the public decoder state to `SEARCH_FOR_FRAME_SYNC` while preserving the stale Ogg link indices, so the later huge seek re-enters Ogg chained-link skipping on an inconsistent `linkdetails` state.

The vulnerable seek path omits the upfront `check_size_of_link_allocation_()` retry that the patch adds, so beginning-of-link BOS scanning in `process_page_()` treats `linkdetails[68]` as a live entry and over-reads `number_of_other_streams`.

fine_trace.var: alloc_check_threshold, init_bools[0], init_bools[4], command_length, command[0], seekpos
fine_trace.note: Harness step. The exact witness prefix `75 17 ff` sets `alloc_check_threshold = 117`, enables Ogg mode and chained-stream decoding, and yields a 15-byte command stream `20 fa 49 2a f5 27 69 69 69 69 69 69 69 69 69`, i.e. `end_of_stream`, `finish_link`, `process_until_end_of_link`, `finish_link`, `flush`, `seek_long(0x6969696969696969)`, then a trailing `process_until_end_of_link` byte that is never reached. `seek.cc` never changes `alloc_check_keep_failing`, so only one later allocation can fail.

Source. Byte 1's bit 4 makes this setter store `decode_chained_stream = true`. That state is what turns later Ogg EOS handling into link bookkeeping with `current_linknumber` and `current_linknumber_advance_read` instead of simply ending the stream.

The saved ASan allocation stack shows this helper successfully growing `linkdetails` during the witness's initial `process_until_end_of_stream()` command. That successful realloc produced the later-crashing 3808-byte region, which is exactly 68 `FLAC__OggDecoderAspect_LinkDetails` slots.
On the crashing stale state, this read-side chained-EOS assignment advances the read-ahead link index from 67 to 68 before capacity is guaranteed.

The immediately following growth attempt must extend the 68-slot array because step 4 made `current_linknumber_advance_read >= number_of_links_allocated`. Under the witness's one injected failure (`alloc_check_threshold = 117`), this wrapped realloc returns `NULL`, so the helper leaves `number_of_links_allocated` at 68 and returns before lines 365-374 can record the current link or increment `number_of_links_indexed`. On the crashing stale state, that leaves `current_linknumber == number_of_links_indexed == 67` with `current_linknumber_advance_read == 68`.

fine_trace.code:
case FLAC__OGG_DECODER_ASPECT_READ_STATUS_NOT_FLAC:
case FLAC__OGG_DECODER_ASPECT_READ_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED_MAPPING_VERSION:
case FLAC__OGG_DECODER_ASPECT_READ_STATUS_ABORT:
case FLAC__OGG_DECODER_ASPECT_READ_STATUS_ERROR:
case FLAC__OGG_DECODER_ASPECT_READ_STATUS_MEMORY_ALLOCATION_ERROR:
	return FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_READ_STATUS_ABORT;
fine_trace.note: The Ogg read adapter does not preserve step 5's distinct `MEMORY_ALLOCATION_ERROR`; it collapses that read-side failure into the generic decoder-side read result `FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_READ_STATUS_ABORT`.
The generic read shim turns step 6 into decoder state `FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_ABORTED` and a false return to whichever public read command was refilling through the bitreader.

The later witnessed `flush` and seek are only source-compatible if step 7 bubbles out through this `frame_sync_()` refill. `FLAC__stream_decoder_process_until_end_of_stream()` lines 1173-1175 and `FLAC__stream_decoder_process_until_end_of_link()` lines 1107-1110 both treat `!frame_sync_()` as a successful public call once the read shim has already set `FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_ABORTED`, whereas failures bubbling out of `find_metadata_()`, `read_metadata_()`, or `read_frame_()` would have made `decoder_valid` false and stopped the harness earlier. The saved artifacts do not distinguish which of those two public commands observed this return.

The witness bytes `0xfa 49 2a` never reset the stale Ogg indices. `finish_link` only runs when `get_state() == FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_END_OF_LINK`, so the two `finish_link` commands are no-ops unless the decoder actually ended a link; the middle `process_until_end_of_link()` call also returns true immediately on `FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_ABORTED`. This three-command subsequence is therefore harmless to the stale Ogg state and does not block the later explicit `flush`.

The explicit `0xf5` command clears decoder buffers and resets the public decoder state to `SEARCH_FOR_FRAME_SYNC`, which is what makes the later `seek_absolute()` call acceptable again. But `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_flush()` does not zero `current_linknumber` or `current_linknumber_advance_read`; only `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_reset()` would, and the witness does not issue `reset`.

The witness's `seek_long` request is accepted after step 10 because `FLAC__stream_decoder_seek_absolute()` allows calls in `SEARCH_FOR_FRAME_SYNC` state (lines 1280-1287). With `decoder->private_->is_ogg` true, it dispatches the same stale decoder object into the Ogg-specific seek path.

The huge target sample `0x6969696969696969` is not covered by the incomplete indexed-link table left after step 5, so `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_get_target_link()` returns `NULL` and the seek loop calls `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()` on the same stale Ogg aspect.

Root cause. `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()` begins the later seek with step 5's stale Ogg indices but does not re-run `check_size_of_link_allocation_()` before branching. With `current_linknumber == number_of_links_indexed == 67`, this `if` is false and the function enters the 'end of current link is unknown' search path that later calls `process_page_()` while `current_linknumber_advance_read` is still 68. The fixing commit inserts the missing helper call immediately above this line.

When the seek-side BOS scan reaches a beginning-of-link page, this path treats the stale read-ahead index as current state and binds `current_link` to `&aspect->linkdetails[68]`. Step 3's heap buffer contains only slots `0..67`, so this pointer is one entry past the allocation.

Sink. This reads the 4-byte `number_of_other_streams` field from the one-past-end `current_link` pointer from step 14. ASan reports the faulting address 32 bytes past the 3808-byte region, which matches the offset of `number_of_other_streams` inside missing entry 68.

allocation_context.note: ASan reports the invalid read is 32 bytes past a 3808-byte heap region last reallocated here. `3808 / sizeof(FLAC__OggDecoderAspect_LinkDetails) = 68`, so the live buffer contains slots `0..67`.

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: The ASan allocation stack points to `check_size_of_link_allocation_:152`, the last successful 68-slot growth of `linkdetails`. The fine trace then shows a later read-side `check_size_of_link_allocation_()` failure is translated into `FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_ABORTED`, a `frame_sync_()`-mediated continuation plus the no-op `0xfa 49 2a` command subsequence keep `flush` reachable, `FLAC__stream_decoder_flush()` preserves the stale Ogg indices while re-enabling seek, and the later seek enters `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()` without the retry that the patch adds, so `process_page_:127-130` reads `linkdetails[68].number_of_other_streams`.

poc.trigger: Stage 01's saved vulnerable run executed `PYTHONPATH=gt_generation python3 -m gt_toolkit arvo-workspace --result-dir /mnt/datastore/gt_generation/gt_results/arvo_379254072 run --version vulnerable --expect crash`, which fed `poc` to `fuzzer_seek` and reproduced `AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 4` in `process_page_` with stack `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link -> seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_ -> FLAC__stream_decoder_seek_absolute`.

format.name: fuzzer_seek command stream + Ogg FLAC payload
format.contract: Exactly the 756034-byte witness stored in `gt_results/arvo_379254072/poc` (sha256 `9c74a08cf368b75fe194572c35cf16e5ca0ef033b9ffdef4d7a28c6f20790bad`). Its 3-byte harness config is `75 17 ff`: byte 0 sets `alloc_check_threshold = 117`, byte 1 enables Ogg mode and `decode_chained_stream`, and byte 2 makes `command_length == 15`. The 15 command bytes are `20 fa 49 2a f5 27 69 69 69 69 69 69 69 69 69`, i.e. `end_of_stream`, `finish_link`, `process_until_end_of_link`, `finish_link`, `flush`, `seek_long(0x6969696969696969)`, then a trailing `process_until_end_of_link` byte that is never reached because the seek already crashes. Because `seek.cc` never changes `alloc_check_keep_failing`, only one allocation may fail. The crash-relevant property of this exact witness is that its initial `process_until_end_of_stream` command grows `linkdetails` to 68 slots, a later read-side growth attempt hits that one injected failure after advancing `current_linknumber_advance_read` to 68, a `frame_sync_()`-mediated public-command exit keeps the harness alive long enough to reach the explicit `flush`, and that `flush` preserves the stale Ogg indices while re-enabling `seek_absolute()`, so the later huge seek enters `process_page_()` on `linkdetails[68]`. This contract is intentionally limited to this exact witness and does not generalize to neighboring payloads or different callback chunking.
